title: Share commit and push actions across environment surfaces
verification: Production Electron proved window.prompt throws 'prompt() is not supported.' Real acceptance then exercised both floating and docked controls against a temporary Git repository and local bare remote: Cancel preserved HEAD; a failing pre-commit hook blocked commit and retained the draft; removing the fixture hook allowed retry; commit subject and clean status were checked; pushed local remote SHA matched HEAD. No hosted Git write occurred in this test. Final production build and web TypeScript with unused checks passed.
notes: Both handlers were equivalent except the docked version silently ignored a missing bridge. One shared action hook now provides consistent errors and finally cleanup, a focused commit-message dialog, captured repository cwd and existing stageAll behavior. Existing panel/card rows and visibility contracts remain. Post-success refresh failure is reported separately from failed Git execution. SA-32 and bounded SR-29 scope adjudication are appended to the report/PSPR. SR-28 committed and pushed at 1acaa13951d7f3add0a9d375ec192e22161b43fa.
